title: DataProf Quality Policy
description: Validation contract for dataprof quality gate policies (--policy FILE). Validates accepted keys, types, ranges, dimension vocabularies, and scopes. Runtime requirement: at least one quality constraint must be specified when executed by check().

min_rows.description: Minimum row count required for the source.

min_quality_score.description: Minimum overall data quality score required (0 to 100).

max_null_percentage.description: Maximum allowable null percentage across columns (0 to 100).

max_duplicate_rows.description: Maximum allowable count of duplicate rows.

require_metrics.description: Required metric packs that must be computed.

require_columns.description: Required column names that must exist in the dataset.

max_quality_score_drop.description: Maximum allowed drop in overall quality score relative to baseline (0 to 100).

max_dimension_score_drops.description: Maximum allowed score drops per quality dimension relative to baseline.

max_null_percentage_increase.description: Maximum allowed increase in null percentage relative to baseline (0 to 100).

forbid_removed_columns.description: Whether to fail the gate if any baseline column is missing from the source.

forbid_added_columns.description: Whether to fail the gate if the source contains columns not present in the baseline.
